csv_project_name: AE Services for 2026 CFP Housing Developments Modernization
csv_scope_of_work: The Belmont Metropolitan Housing Authority (BMHA) is in the development stage of a 2026 Capital Fund Program (CFP) to modernize the housing developments which it owns and manages in Belmont County, Ohio; specifically; fifteen (15) different development sites consisting of family and high rise units. The Authority is accepting proposals from firms interested in providing architectural and engineering services to assist the Authority in the planning and development of this modernization project. The Authority will be selecting an architectural/engineering firm through the competitive negotiation process.
